description: A vast, primordial woodland stretching northeast of Lumenport where ancient roots intertwine with petrified glass strata and wild Aether springs.

districts.name: Rootbridge Crossing
districts.flavor: A suspended living bridge woven from colossal ironwood boughs over the roaring Amberfall chasm.

districts.name: Whispering Canopy
districts.flavor: Dappled sunlight filters through emerald foliage where duelists gather on natural moss stone stages.

districts.name: Old Growth Shaded Glen
districts.flavor: Towering thousand-year trunks surrounded by luminous spore-ferns and wild fauna.

districts.name: Sporewood Sanctuary
districts.flavor: The sacred heart of the Verdant Pact, where hollow wood temples house ancient resonance conduits.

npcs.name: Elder Orla of the Canopy
npcs.title: First Keeper of the Living Boughs

dialogue.greeting: The forest remembers what cities forget, Wanderer. Speak with quiet boots upon these roots.
dialogue.friendly: Your Aether hums with the pulse of green growth. The boughs do not turn against you.
dialogue.bonded: Take this seedspeaker's talisman. When the city walls crumble, the expanse remains.
dialogue.victory: A duel well struck. Even the highest oaks bend before a patient gale.
dialogue.defeat: The woods have tested your footing, duelist. Stand, and drink from the font.

dialogue.greeting: Toll's waived for duelists who carry clean steel and respect the canopy.
dialogue.friendly: Seen any beasts near the chasm? The convergence stirs them up fierce.
dialogue.bonded: You fight like you were born between ironwood trunks. Glad to share a campfire.
dialogue.victory: Fast hands, friend! You caught my flank wide open.
dialogue.defeat: Gotta watch the leaves, kid. They telegraph where the strike lands.

dialogue.greeting: Mind the violet caps—breathe deep and you'll think your cards are talking back to you.
dialogue.friendly: Need restorative distillates or raw Echo Dust? I trade fair, city crowns or wild seeds.
dialogue.bonded: Between you and me, the Grand Tournament scouts were out here snooping yesterday.
dialogue.victory: Impressive! You turned my spore swarm right back against me.
dialogue.defeat: Too slow on the counter-spell! That's how the glen takes you.

dialogue.greeting: The wind carries word from Lumenport. They say a new champion walks the cobbles.
dialogue.friendly: Do you feel the resonance in the tree bark? The Accord cannot pave the whole world.
dialogue.bonded: You are a friend to the silent wood. Call upon my thorns whenever your vanguard needs cover.
dialogue.victory: Graceful and unrelenting. A duel worthy of song.
dialogue.defeat: Your roots were shallow that turn. Deepen your stance.

quests.title: Trial of the Rootbridge
quests.objective: Defeat Ranger Bram in a standard 1v1 duel to secure safe transit into the Expanse.

quests.title: Sporewood Reclamation
quests.objective: Investigate anomalous Gravewild creeping vines in the Old Growth Glen and purify them in combat.

quests.title: Boughs of the First Concord
quests.objective: Complete the 2v2 Tag Convergence Trial in the Sporewood Sanctuary alongside Ranger Bram.
